items.content: Anthropomorphization of AI is good when it serves to help us use (understand, predict, etc) AI better. It’s bad when it serves to sow panic, fear, and unrealistic / unwarranted comparisons to human beings. Most opponents of anthropomorphism are rightly reacting to its misuse to sow panic or alter the moral status of agents by claiming consciousness etc. It’s possible to use anthropomorphism without doing that though
